prior_attempt.classification: MODFLOW harness configuration failure before any coupled-window result
prior_attempt.cause: The two-period TDIS vector did not match the scalar PERLEN write made by the existing XMI prepare_time_step adapter. MODFLOW reported mem_set_value size mismatch for PERLEN; C2a/C2b physics did not run.

execution_repair.method: Use one normal single-period MODFLOW6 API simulation for each coupling window. After accepted C2a, finalize and close that MODFLOW instance, copy its accepted XOLD head vector exactly into the initial-head array of the new single-period C2b simulation, and retain the same live SWAP application context and committed SWAP state.
execution_repair.justification: The registered MODFLOW model has no STO and no independent physical aquifer storage. At a committed window boundary, the MODFLOW head vector is its only aquifer dynamic state. Reinitializing the next one-period API instance with accepted XOLD is a committed-only head-state continuation, not a restart of prepared/Newton scratch.
retained_semantics: C2a then C2b sequential SWAP commits
MODFLOW-finalize then SWAP commit then ledger commit

claim_ceiling: Two-window research sequence only; this single-period API reinitialization does not qualify production restart persistence or Hupsel coupling.
